title: Stock picks of the week: 6 stocks with consistent score improvement and upside potential of up to 26%
summary: The US-Iran war continues to create uncertainty for markets across the globe. But more so in India, due to the high correlation between energy costs and inflation and, subsequently, consumption. Adding to the uncertainty, at least in some sectors, is the renewal of the tariff war. Our selected stocks for today depict a strong upward trajectory in their overall average score which is based on five key pillars: Earnings, fundamentals, relative valuation, risk, and price momentum. This implies that there has been a significant improvement in their market outlook in the given time frame.
